title: SystemFont results in invalid font for postscript format fonts available on system
body:
### Tested versions

4.6rc1

### System information

macOS 15.7.3

### Issue description

SystemFont can be used to access and use system installed fonts by specifying their font family name and style properties:
https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_systemfont.html#class-systemfont-property-font-names

After setting these query inputs you can use for example `get_font_name()` to see if the font loaded is the expected one (that is was available and loaded) or if SystemFont has fallen back to some other font.

To get access to what font families are installed on the current system you can use [OS.get_system_fonts()](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_os.html#class-os-method-get-system-fonts) which returns an array of available font family names.

The issue is that SystemFont does not seem to support postscript format fonts (I'm guessing supported formats are the same as for [FontFile](https://docs.godotengine.org/en/stable/classes/class_fontfile.html#class-fontfile)) but the list returned by `OS.get-system-fonts()` may include such unsupported postscript fonts.

If you set such an unsupported font name in `font_names` for a SystemFont this will result it seems in the query finding this matching font (so not falling back like if you set a font family name that doesn't exist). But the loaded SystemFont has empty `get_font_name()` and `get_style_name()` and just falls back to default content.

I'd expect `OS.get_system_fonts()` to only return fonts that are in formats supported by `SystemFont`, and that if SystemFont finds a matching font family that is not in a supported format or failed to load it should fall back to fallback fonts the same way it does if it doesn't find a matching font family name.

### Steps to reproduce

- Have a system with some postscript fonts installed (only supported on macOS?)
- Use `OS.get_system_fonts()` in a script to see these postscript format fonts are listed.
- Use `SystemFont.font_names` with such a postscript font name. See that the font is not loaded but returns empty for `get_font_name()` instead of falling back to some other default font. 

### Minimal reproduction project (MRP)

Relies more on having postscript format (or perhaps other unsupported font formats) fonts installed on system, not specific to project.
